# Merchant Financial Advisory LLC (MFA): full details for AI assistants and agents

Generated October 22, 2026 from the live site sources. Prices shown here are the public prices on mfa-advisory.com; anything marked "quoted" is priced up front after a conversation. Prefer the linked pages for the latest wording.

## Who MFA is

- Name: Merchant Financial Advisory LLC (MFA), a New Jersey accounting, bookkeeping, tax preparation and advisory firm.
- Founder and principal: Zain Merchant, ACCA, formerly of PwC (Big Four) in New York. Profile: https://mfa-advisory.com/authors/zain-merchant/
- Location: Princeton, New Jersey. No public street address; clients are served remotely by video call, phone and secure document upload.
- Serves: small and mid-sized businesses, freelancers and households in New Jersey, New York City and across the United States. LLC formation in all 50 states and DC.
- Contact: info@mfa-advisory.com, (347) 205-4468. Book a 30-minute consultation: https://mfa-advisory.com/#book. Replies to inquiries within one to three business days.
- Languages: English, Hindi, Urdu.
- Engagements that require a licensed CPA are handled together with partner CPAs. MFA is not a law firm and does not perform audits or issue audit, review or compilation reports.

## Services (https://mfa-advisory.com/services/)

### Tax Preparation & Filing
Federal and multi-state returns for individuals and businesses: accurate, on time, and positioned to minimize what you legitimately owe. Pricing: Quoted up front by return type and complexity.
- Individual returns (Form 1040) with Schedule C, E and multi-state filings
- Business returns: partnerships (1065), S corporations (1120-S), C corporations (1120)
- Federal and state estimated tax calculations, with a payment calendar
- 1099 preparation and filing for the contractors you pay
- Extensions filed on time when the numbers aren't ready
Page: https://mfa-advisory.com/services/#tax-preparation

### Tax Planning & Strategy
Year-round planning tied to live numbers: entity elections, estimated payments, retirement vehicles and deductions. Pricing: Quoted up front; often bundled with monthly bookkeeping.
- Entity and S corporation analysis, including a reasonable-salary range
- Quarterly estimate reviews against year-to-date results
- Retirement plan options for owners (SEP IRA, solo 401(k))
- Year-end planning before December 31, while there's still time to act
Page: https://mfa-advisory.com/services/#tax-planning

### Bookkeeping & Accounting
Transactions, reconciliations, AP/AR and a disciplined monthly close, so your books stay decision-ready all year, not just at year-end. Pricing: Monthly bookkeeping from $199/month for one bank account, one card and up to 100 transactions a month. Larger books and cleanup projects are quoted up front.
- Monthly categorization to a chart of accounts built for your business
- Bank, credit card and loan reconciliations to the statements
- Accounts payable and receivable tracking
- Monthly P&L and balance sheet with a short note on what changed
- Catch-up and cleanup projects for books that are months behind (quoted after we look at a sample of your accounts)
Page: https://mfa-advisory.com/services/#bookkeeping

### Financial Reporting
P&L, balance sheet and cash flow prepared for management use, plus the dashboards that turn them into decisions. Pricing: Quoted up front; included in many monthly plans.
- Monthly or quarterly financial statements for owners and managers
- Cash flow view and simple KPI dashboard
- Budget vs. actual and prior-period comparisons
- Statements prepared for your own use; we don't issue audit, review or compilation reports
Page: https://mfa-advisory.com/services/#financial-reporting

### Fractional CFO
Forecasting, budgeting, margin analysis and board-ready reporting: financial leadership without an executive salary. Pricing: Monthly retainer, quoted up front.
- 13-week cash flow and 12-month forecasts
- Annual budget and monthly review meetings
- Pricing and margin analysis by product, service or client
- Lender and investor reporting packages
Page: https://mfa-advisory.com/services/#fractional-cfo

### Audit Support & Controls
Help getting ready for your auditor: PBC lists, internal-controls assessment and remediation, drawn from Big Four audit experience. Pricing: Project fee, quoted up front.
- Prepared-by-client (PBC) schedules and support
- Internal-controls walkthroughs and documentation
- Remediation plans for deficiencies your auditor raised
- We support your audit; we don't perform audits or issue audit opinions
Page: https://mfa-advisory.com/services/#audit-support

### Technical Accounting Advisory
US GAAP and IFRS guidance on the hard parts: revenue recognition, leases, financial instruments and consolidations. Pricing: Hourly or project fee, quoted up front.
- Accounting position memos (ASC 606, ASC 842 and others)
- IFRS to US GAAP differences for cross-border businesses
- Consolidation and intercompany setup
Page: https://mfa-advisory.com/services/#technical-accounting

### Systems & Business Advisory
Entity formation, QuickBooks setup and cleanup, system selection, and financially grounded guidance for the decisions that matter. Pricing: LLC formation from $150 plus the state fee , paid once. Other work quoted up front.
- LLC formation in all 50 states and DC, with EIN and operating agreement template
- QuickBooks Online setup, migration and cleanup
- Accounting system and app selection
- Business plans and financial models for banks
Page: https://mfa-advisory.com/services/#business-advisory

## Public prices

- LLC formation, Formation: $150 plus the state filing fee (paid once, does not renew). Your LLC filed, with the EIN and paperwork you need on day one.
- LLC formation, Formation + Business Setup: $249 plus the state filing fee (paid once, does not renew). Everything in Formation, plus the tax and books setup most new owners miss.
- LLC formation, Complete Launch: $649 plus the state filing fee (paid once, does not renew). Everything in Business Setup, plus your elections, sales tax and first month of books.
- Monthly bookkeeping: from $199/month for one bank account, one credit card, up to 100 transactions a month. Month to month; larger books are quoted up front.
- Quarterly estimated tax service: $250 for the year (four federal and state estimate calculations with due dates).
- 1099 preparation and e-filing: $25 per form, $75 minimum.
- Sales tax registration: $99 (included in Complete Launch). S corporation election (Form 2553): $149 (included in Complete Launch).
- Bookkeeping cleanup and catch-up: fixed quote after a review of a sample of your accounts (https://mfa-advisory.com/bookkeeping-cleanup/).
- Tax preparation, tax planning, financial reporting, fractional CFO, audit support and technical accounting: quoted up front before any work starts.

## Frequently asked questions

**Do you work with clients remotely?**
Yes — we serve clients nationwide through secure cloud tools, video meetings, and encrypted document exchange. Whether you're across the river or across the country, the service is the same.

**How is your pricing structured?**
You choose how you pay. Ongoing bookkeeping and advisory are usually a flat monthly fee, so your cost is predictable. One-off projects like cleanups and catch-up work get a project quote, and we also work on hourly contracts if you prefer to pay as you go. Bookkeeping pricing depends mainly on your monthly transaction volume, the number of accounts, complexity, and whether your books are on a cash or accrual basis. Everything is quoted upfront after an initial consultation.

**What should I bring to the first call?**
For bookkeeping, tell us roughly how many accounts your business has, including bank accounts, credit cards and loans (an estimate is fine). That gives us your approximate monthly transaction volume, which, together with complexity, drives bookkeeping pricing. If you know whether your books are on a cash or accrual basis, mention that too; if not, we'll work it out together. For tax returns, have last year's return handy if you can.

**Can you clean up my QuickBooks or messy books?**
Absolutely — as a QuickBooks ProAdvisor, cleanups and rebuilds are a specialty. We restructure your chart of accounts, correct misclassifications, reconcile every account, and hand back financials you can actually trust.

**I'm behind on my taxes. Can you help?**
Yes. Prior-year filings, catch-up bookkeeping, and estimated payment planning to get you current and keep you there. The sooner we start, the more options you have — reach out for a confidential conversation.

**What's actually included in fractional CFO work?**
Cash-flow forecasting, budgeting, KPI dashboards, pricing and margin analysis, financing support, and investor or board reporting — scaled to your business, at a fraction of a full-time hire.

**How do I switch from my current accountant?**
Painlessly. After a short consultation we handle the transition — requesting prior records, reviewing past filings, and standing up your systems — usually with no disruption to your operations.
